name: Pimen
venerable mothers and martyrs Lavrentia (Herasymiv) and Olympia (Bida)
troparia: (Tone 8) Your abundant tears made the wilderness bloom,* and your sufferings made your labours fruitful a hundredfold;* you became a shining torch over the world.* O venerable father Pimen,* pray to Christ our God that He may save our souls.
